dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white spotting on the outer webs of flight feathers, appearing as distinct white bands against a dark gray background.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent white spots creating a high-contrast serrated appearance along the outer edge of the folded wings.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast red rectangular patch is visible on the posterior crown/upper nape area.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Indistinct; the grayscale plumage of the crown blends into the mantle without a clear boundary line.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent, high-contrast white patch on the rump/lower back, creating a sharp boundary with the dark gray mantle and tail.
